project: Sanjeevani synthetic outbreak early warning and detection

labels.M1: New simulated outbreak onset after prediction time within 7 days
labels.M2: Simulated outbreak active at prediction time

generated_inputs: exposure, infection, symptoms and outbreak events
sensor, laboratory, ASHA, OPD and IDSP-like observations
limitations: No model result is a real district outbreak forecast.
Synthetic alerts cannot establish drinking water safety or clinical risk.
The simulator parameters include explicit assumptions and need independent validation.
